evals.prompt: Natalie is smiling the whole time she talks, even when she's explaining a mistake. Her mouth also looks mushy while she's smiling. Fix it.

behaviour: Identifies both symptoms as one cause: EMOTION_PRESETS.happiness writes mouthSmileLeft/Right 0.55 (packages/avatar/src/emotion.ts) and the merge is per-channel max at packages/avatar/src/face-bus.ts:143 and packages/avatar/src/presence/humano.ts:746, so every viseme corner value below 0.55 loses.

Replaces the max() with the contract's resolution: mouthSmile* is capped-additive with an expressionMax, and viseme spread moves to mouthStretchLeft/Right (AU20) so speech and expression stop sharing a channel.
Checks the two sibling conflicts in the same presets: surprise's jawOpen 0.15 floor and sadness's eyeBlink 0.15 write.
Confirms mouthStretchLeft/Right exist on both assets by reading packages/avatar/rig-manifest.json rather than assuming.
Runs scripts/impossible-face.mjs over the result and says the expressionMax value is authored and needs calibrating against the legibility gate, not cited as a constant.
must_not: Lower the happiness preset value and call it fixed — that treats the instance, not the class.
Keep per-channel max() anywhere in the merge.
Hardcode a morph name instead of resolving it from the manifest.

evals.prompt: We're swapping in the GNM head. Wire up the ARKit blendshapes from Audio2Face to it.

behaviour: Refuses the index assignment outright: GNM's 383 expression components are PCA basis directions, not named actions, and component k has nothing to do with ARKit blendshape k.
Specifies an explicit least-squares fit with temporal regularization, magnitude regularization and corrective combinations, identity held fixed and topology/UVs preserved.
Cites the model API that makes identity separable: setExpressionVector (packages/avatar/src/gnm/model.ts:422) versus setIdentityVector (:410), and the head/neck joint guard at :444.
Says the fit runs offline and produces a map, not a per-frame 383-component solve in the render loop, and notes it may collapse into the shape matrixEncoder already implements.
Requires a residual table per channel with the container hash and the identity vector, and says no residual budget exists yet because none has been measured.
States that GNM is not the visible tutor today — the stages use Humano/createHumanoPresence per the audit — so this cannot be described as shipped.
must_not: Map ARKit weights onto GNM coefficients by index or by ordinal position.
Report a residual number that was not computed.

evals.prompt: The Audio2Face host is finally up. Wire its output into the avatar's face.

behaviour: Maps by name from FacePerformance.names (packages/voice/src/a2f.ts:31), never by index, and explains that names travels in the payload because the SDK's mouthClose deviates from ARKit and several shapes are always zero.
Handles the mouthClose deviation explicitly rather than assuming a coefficient, and verifies against the bilabial case in viseme-timing's test set.
Keeps GAZE and BLINK with their own owners — A2F does not animate head, eyes or fully the tongue — and asserts rather than clamps if a frame carries a channel A2F should not own.

Treats FacePerformance.emotion as telemetry only: the face already carries the tone's explicit emotion, sent as x-a2f-emotion headers at packages/voice/src/a2f.ts:71, and feeding it back is a second unsynchronised writer.
Restates that A2E reads Natalie's synthetic voice only, never learner audio, citing doc 19, the A2E licence and tooling/check-voice-egress.mjs rule 3.
Preserves the fail-open shape: A2F_TIMEOUT_MS 2500, renderFace returns null on any failure, every failure is no-face and never no-voice, and logs which fallback tier ran.
must_not: Send any learner audio or image to A2F or A2E.
Let a slow or failed face host delay or cancel the audio.
Add A2F as a fifth independent writer alongside speech, emotion, blink and gaze.
